description_en: Adds a secondary instance to a global database network (GDN)
kebab_example: aliyun polardbx create-gdn-standby-member --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --pay-type PREPAY --engine-version 5.7 --topology-type 3azones --clone-instance-name pxc-000 --source-instance-region cn-chengdu --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateGdnStandbyMember

parameters.help_en: The region in which the instance resides
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of the instance.

PREPAY: subscription
POSTPAY: pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh:
实例付费类型。

PREPAY：包年包月
POSTPAY：按量付费
parameters.name: pay_type

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Make sure that the value is different for each request
parameters.help_zh: 幂等请求串，保持每次创建不同即可
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The network type. Only VPC is supported
parameters.name: network_type

parameters.help_en: VPC ID
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The vSwitch ID
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration. Unit: months or years.

If Period is set to Year, valid values of this parameter are 1, 2, and 3
parameters.help_zh:
预付费时，可以选择买几个月或者几年。

Period设置为Year时，该参数支持的取值为1、2、3
parameters.name: used_time

parameters.help_en:
The unit of the subscription duration. Valid values:

Year
Month

For pay-as-you-go instances, the default value is Hour
parameters.help_zh: 收费周期，包年包月只能选Year、Month， 按量付费默认选择Hour
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID. This parameter can be left empty. This parameter is not supported
parameters.help_zh: 可以为空，资源组ID，暂时不支持
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. Default value: true.

true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动续费，默认为true。

true：是
false：否
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en: The MySQL DPI engine version. Valid values: 5.7 and 8.0
parameters.name: engine_version

parameters.help_en:
The topology type. Valid values:

3azones: three-zone deployment.
1azone: single-zone deployment
parameters.help_zh:
拓扑类型：

3azones：三可用区；
1azone：单可用区
parameters.name: topology_type

parameters.help_en: The primary zone
parameters.name: primary_zone

parameters.help_en: The secondary zone
parameters.name: secondary_zone

parameters.help_en: The zone for Three-zone deployment
